articles.title: Crypto’s next billion-dollar hacker may move at superhuman speed
articles.snippet: Anthropic’s new Claude Fable 5 puts powerful cyber tools behind safety filters. DeFi, already hit by more than $840 million in hacks this year, is one of the industries with the most to lose if the filters fail.

articles.title: Here's what SpaceX's IPO means for its $1.3 billion bitcoin reserve
articles.snippet: The largest company on public markets now holds bitcoin as a treasury reserve, not as a business model. Its first earnings cycles will test which version of corporate crypto survives a bear market.

articles.title: Bloomberg Analyst: Most Bitcoin ETF Investors Have Stayed Put Despite Outflows
articles.snippet: Bitcoin ETF investors have pulled billions this year, but the broader crypto ETF market remains more resilient than recent headlines suggest.

articles.title: The U.S. government is betting $2 Billion on quantum computing, and the defense side can't keep up
articles.snippet: Pruden argues that to defend against a quantum computer capable of cryptographically relevant operations, we need post-quantum cryptography and regulatory coordination that the industry has been deferring for years.

articles.title: Polish president vetoes crypto bill for third time ahead of MiCA deadline
articles.snippet: Polish President Karol Nawrocki vetoed a bill to implement MiCA for the third time, just weeks before the end of the EU crypto framework's transitional period.
